issues.title: Ingest Marion County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $16,755,059 across 38 funds. The largest: County General Fund ($5,451,502), County Road Fund ($3,267,931), Sales Tax - Road Dept ($1,862,072). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
